overview_description.description:
Eighty6 is a cutting-edge SaaS platform, specializing in B2B FoodTech solutions. Our mission is to revolutionize the way businesses in the food industry manage their procurement and sales processes. By leveraging advanced AI technology, Eighty6 aims to streamline and digitize these critical operations, bringing efficiency, transparency, and innovation to the forefront.

Key Features:

1.	AI-Driven Procurement:
•	Harness the power of AI to optimize procurement processes.
•	Intelligent demand forecasting for better inventory management.
2.	Smart Sales Solutions:
•	AI-assisted sales strategies for personalized and effective transactions.
•	Predictive analytics to identify potential sales opportunities.
3.	Enhanced Supply Chain Management:
•	AI-powered insights for proactive supply chain optimization.
•	Adaptive logistics for real-time adjustments.
4.	Data-Driven Decision-Making:
•	Real-time analytics and reporting for actionable insights.
•	Historical data analysis for strategic planning.
5.	Customized AI Solutions:
•	Tailor AI functionalities to meet the specific needs of your business.
•	Continuous learning algorithms for adaptive performance

The processes 

Facilitate digital transactions for seamless sales operations.
Provide a user-friendly interface for easy navigation.
Efficient Supply Chain Management:

Optimize supply chain processes for improved logistics.
Minimize delays and enhance overall supply chain efficiency.
Real-time Data Insights:

Harness the power of real-time data analytics for informed decision-making.
Track and analyze procurement and sales performance.
Customized Solutions:

Tailor the platform to meet the unique needs of each business.
Provide flexibility to adapt to evolving industry trends

product.name: Eighty6 Sales & Ordering Platform
product.description: A SaaS platform that automates and digitizes the entire B2B order-taking process for food and beverage suppliers and distributors, centralizing orders from multiple channels into one dashboard.

product.name: Eighty6 AI Inbox
product.description: An AI-powered feature that automatically converts orders received via WhatsApp, emails, and voice notes into digital orders, syncing them with ERP systems without manual input.

product.name: Eighty6 Food Procurement Platform
product.description: A digital procurement platform connecting chefs and restaurant owners with a network of trusted food and beverage suppliers for streamlined ordering and inventory management.

product.name: Eighty6 Restaurant Inventory Management Software
product.description: Software designed to help restaurants track and manage their inventory, including perishable and non-perishable goods, to optimize stock levels and reduce waste.

product.name: Eighty6 Food Financing ERP
product.description: A financial service integrated with ERP systems offering cash advances to food and beverage businesses to support inventory purchases and manage cash flow.
